author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇺🇸 Lindsay Clancy’s ex-husband says he still "talks" to the three children she killed

Patrick Clancy says he speaks to Cora, Dawson and Callan constantly, sometimes pleading with them for strength:

“𝘏𝘦𝘭𝘱 𝘮𝘦. 𝘈𝘭𝘭 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘪𝘮𝘦.”

Writer: Sol
